city_name: Ilha do Mel & Pontal do Paraná, Brazil

boarding_points.name: Terminal Aquaviário Público de Pontal do Sul
boarding_points.linked_locale: Pontal do Paraná (Balneário Pontal do Sul)
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Pontal do Paraná (terminal) / Abaline + SEIL-credentialed vessels; AGEPAR-regulated
boarding_points.notes: The only authorized mainland embarkation point for the regulated Ilha do Mel crossing (Rua Alameda do Café s/n). Regular barcas + nautical taxis; official ticket office. OSM 'Terminal de Embarque de Pontal do Sul' / 'Trapiche de Pontal do Sul' cross-checked.

boarding_points.name: Ilha do Mel — Trapiche de Nova Brasília
boarding_points.linked_locale: Ilha do Mel (Nova Brasília / Brasília village)
boarding_points.operator: Public trapiche; crossings by Abaline + credentialed nautical taxis
boarding_points.notes: Main island pier; designated Terminal Nova Brasília under the new access framework (5,903-visitor share of the 11k cap). OSM ferry_terminal 'Nova Brasília' matches IAT map link (-25.5424, -48.3042).

boarding_points.name: Ilha do Mel — Trapiche de Encantadas
boarding_points.operator: Public trapiche; crossings by Abaline + credentialed nautical taxis
boarding_points.notes: Southern village pier; designated Terminal Encantadas under the new access framework (5,146-visitor share). OSM ferry_terminal 'Encantadas' + adjacent 'Encantadas embarque'.

boarding_points.name: Paranaguá waterfront embarkation (Rua da Praia / Trapiche do Golfinho)
boarding_points.operator: Abaline / Barcopar boats; embarkation beside the Posto Marítimo
boarding_points.notes: Departure point for Ilha do Mel (daily, 1h30, ~R$80-90), Superagui (Mon-Fri 14:00, R$60), Ilha das Peças (R$40), Amparo (Trapiche do Rocio) and Guaraqueçaba taxis. OSM ferry_terminal adjoining 'Trapiche do Golfinho' pier. Nearby Trapiche do Rocio (-48.531513, -25.503502) serves Amparo. Ilha dos Valadares is reached by footbridge and a short river balsa — not a viable network route.

boarding_points.name: Ilha das Peças trapiche
boarding_points.operator: Community boats / Barcopar-associated lines from Paranaguá (R$40)
boarding_points.notes: Fishing-village island inside the Superagui NP buffer; scheduled boats from Paranaguá Mon-Sat. OSM ferry_terminal 'Ilha das Peças'.

boarding_points.name: Barra do Superagui trapiche (Superagui National Park)
boarding_points.operator: Community boats; scheduled weekday boat from Paranaguá (14:00, R$60, ~3h); Abaline excursions from Ilha do Mel
boarding_points.notes: Gateway village of Superagui National Park, UNESCO Atlantic Forest World Heritage (Lagamar). Boat-only access. OSM ferry_terminal 'Superagui' (+ 'Voadeira' fast-boat point).

boarding_points.name: Guaraqueçaba town trapiche
boarding_points.notes: OSM ferry_terminal + pier cluster on the Guaraqueçaba town waterfront (Costão sector, confirmed by reverse geocode); OSM feature unnamed, so treat as medium confidence pending survey. Road access to town is a notoriously poor dirt road — water is the practical link.

boarding_points.name: Ponta do Poço marina (Pontal do Paraná)
boarding_points.operator: Private marina cluster (deep-water nautical zone of Pontal do Paraná)
boarding_points.notes: Deepest natural berth area in the bay mouth; marina/boatyard cluster. OSM marina 'Ponta do Poço'. Charter/maintenance spur and potential charging node.

boarding_points.name: Iate Clube Pontal do Sul
boarding_points.linked_locale: Pontal do Paraná (DNOS canal, Pontal do Sul)
boarding_points.notes: Yacht-club marina on the Pontal do Sul canal, ~300 m from the public terminal; premium-charter spur. OSM marina 'Iate Clube Pontal Do Sul'.
